title: Vision organ v2 sealed test: frozen r3h-B with tile_decoder_v2, paired against the routine and against r3h-B with v1
authority: David approved sealing v2 before any canonical vision swap (2026-10-09); Sol: 'give v2 its own locked one-time sealed test' (DAV-90)

candidate.path: copy of frozen candidates/r3h-B with one organ swap v1 -> v2 (cb2_organ_swap.py)
candidate.frozen: no retraining, no tuning after sealed outcomes are visible

comparator.what: frozen candidates/r3h-B (vision v1), same protocol, same worlds

seeds_use: once; never used before (90001-90040 spent on r3-H; 90041-90080 reserved for S2)
label: v2-sealed

non_inferiority_vs_v1.method: paired per-world survival difference v2 - v1; one-sided 95% lower bound = 5th percentile of 10,000 bootstrap means (numpy default_rng(20261009))

pass: the four r3-H gates for v2 (score, survival, requests vs routine; continuity incl. the organ: integrity, save/restore, consolidation round-trip, replay of 90081, 100% delegation provenance) AND non-inferiority vs v1 AND no protocol deviation
superiority_reported_if: the lower bound of the paired survival difference v2 - v1 > 0 (reported, not required)
meaning_if_pass: v2 may replace v1 in the canonical individual by a recorded organ swap (David's decision)
executor: scripts/explore/cb2_sealed_v2.py (wraps cb2_sealed_r3h.py for the candidate and cb2_evaluate.py for the v1 comparator)
